test_title: PYST 16: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 12 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Shekhar Kapur received the Padma Bhushan in 2025 for his work in which field?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Art**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** is a renowned Indian filmmaker and actor known for his significant contributions to the world of **cinema and visual arts**.
 
• He gained international acclaim for directing the historical films **“Elizabeth” (1998)** and its sequel **“Elizabeth: The Golden Age” (2007).**
 
• His critically acclaimed films include **“Bandit Queen” (1994)**, based on the life of Phoolan Devi, and **“Masoom” (1983)**, marking his debut as a director.
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** has been recognized for his creative storytelling, exceptional cinematic techniques, and impactful portrayal of complex characters.
 
• He received the **Padma Bhushan in 2025**, India's third-highest civilian award, for his outstanding work in the field of **Art**, particularly in filmmaking and visual storytelling.
 
• His contributions have greatly enriched the **global film industry**, bridging the gap between Indian and international cinema.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Science**__

 __
 
• The field of **science** involves systematic studies of the structure and behavior of the physical and natural world through observation and experimentation.
 
• While Shekhar Kapur has demonstrated creativity and innovation, his expertise lies in filmmaking and not in the domain of scientific research or discovery.
 
 
 
• **Medicine**__
 __
 
• **Medicine** is a field concerned with the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases.
 
• Shekhar Kapur has no known contributions or achievements in the field of medicine.
 
 
 
• **Literature**__
 
 
• **Literature** refers to written works, especially those considered of superior or lasting artistic merit.
 
• Although storytelling is a part of Shekhar Kapur’s work as a filmmaker, his primary contributions are in the realm of visual storytelling and not written literature.
